title: Reset password
purpose: Request recovery instructions for the email address associated with your account.
summary: Ask for a password reset link for the email address on your account.

tasks.title: Get a reset link
steps: Type the email on your account in [[Email]].
Select [[Reset my password]], then follow the link in the email within three days.

tasks.title: Go back without resetting
steps: Select the Smart Roots name at the top to return to sign in.

good_to_know: The confirmation looks the same whether or not an account was found.
Requests are rate limited. Nothing changes until you use the link.
Shared demonstration accounts get no reset link; their published password cannot change.

items.label: Email
items.description: Required valid email address, normalized to lowercase. Looks for active accounts using this email and prefers verified matching addresses.

items.label: Reset my password
items.description: Requests a reset link, subject to rate limits. The same acknowledgement is shown when no eligible account is found; it does not reveal existence or change a password. The account may receive an informational message instead of a usable reset link for an unknown address. No link is mailed for a shared demonstration account, whose published password cannot be changed; the acknowledgement is the same.

sections.title: Delivery and navigation
paragraphs: This deployment uses link-based password recovery; reset-by-code is not enabled. Outgoing mail defaults to the console backend unless the deployer configures delivery, so the page’s sent acknowledgement does not establish inbox delivery. A signed-in visitor sees a reminder naming the account currently signed in. There is no dedicated Sign in action in this stock reset form; the application brand links to the dashboard/sign-in journey. A valid link, normally expiring after three days, is required for replacement.
